exactSupportingSpans.quote: The unit of analysis in this book is not a technology by itself.
Its most faithful behavior destroys its easiest business model.
A subscription model could work for affluent users, but universal deployment would require a public or cooperative option.
The purpose of the map is to locate the decision, not to predetermine it.
The contradiction is not resolved by a better pitch deck.
Most of the cases in this book require no hidden coordination and no villain.
It is a project inside a selection environment.
The method begins by reconstructing the project without forcing it into an existing organizational form.
The next step is to identify the selecting institutions and their legitimate mandates.
The anti-consumption agent is a useful thought experiment.
It negotiates, compares, recommends used goods, or advises waiting.
The platforms best positioned to distribute it may earn from transactions or attention.
Manufacturers may profit from services, but durable repairable products can cannibalize replacement revenue.
The appropriate conclusion is not that anti-venture projects cannot involve companies.
Outfinitism begins from finite but movable limits.
Privacy restricts useful data flows because people are not raw material.
The right at stake is not a right to build everything.

The book therefore asks, throughout: which actor vanishes from the story, which cost moves to another budget or decade, which metric substitutes for the real objective, which failure is rewritten as progress, and which conflict is presented as a mere implementation gap?
